title: LogReg-First: Add logistic_regression to NBA GA candidate pool (SOTA + live P7 corroboration)

sota_evidence.source: MDPI Computation 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sota_evidence.finding: Logistic regression achieves Brier 0.199 on 2024 NBA test data — best tabular baseline, beating XGBoost (0.202), CNN (0.221).
sota_evidence.features_used: team ELO rating (team_elo_5_y), home advantage, rolling 5-game win rate, rest days

sota_evidence.source: PMC 2024 — XGBoost + SHAP for NBA game outcome
sota_evidence.finding: Top-3 SHAP features: home_next, team_elo_5_y, team_elo. XGBoost Brier 0.202. ELO signal dominates.

live_corroboration.result: P7 is the current POL LIVE BEST across all 5 political islands — beating catboost (P1 0.25456), xgboost_brier (P2 0.24997), and logistic_regression competitors (P4 0.25646). Direct evidence that logistic_regression GA candidates produce top-tier results in the Nomos42 multi-island architecture.

proposal.action: Add logistic_regression as an explicit model type in the NBA GA candidate initialization.
proposal.current_state: NBA islands use: random_forest (S13, S14), extra_trees (S15, S18), catboost (S22), xgboost (S17 DOWN). No logistic_regression island currently active.
proposal.target: Repurpose S22 (lowest current gen=718, freshly restarted) to test logistic_regression as primary algo. Or configure as a new mutation target in the GA init pool.
implementation: In hf-nba-evo app.py: add 'logistic_regression' to MODEL_TYPES list and implement _train_logistic_regression() using sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=1000) + CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=5, method='isotonic')
Feature selection: use GA selected features (50-200 from engine.py pool) — logistic regression is L2-regularized so handles moderate feature counts
Isotonic calibration mandatory: CalibratedClassifierCV wrapping, matching SOTA paper methodology
Expected Brier: ~0.222-0.225 initially (same candidate pool as current islands), with potential to reach ~0.215 with ELO-optimized feature subset
proposal.risk: LOW — logistic regression trains fast on CPU (seconds vs minutes for tree ensembles), reducing per-generation time and allowing more GA cycles per hour.

cross_project_port.to: NBA Islands (add logistic_regression as GA candidate)
cross_project_port.mechanism: P7 running logistic_regression for 29900 gens vs P4 xgboost_brier 6373 gens suggests logistic_regression is more stable and less prone to restart-based gen loss. CPU training speed advantage enables 5-10x more gens per wall-clock hour.

elo_feature_gap.finding: All SOTA papers identify ELO as top predictor. features/engine.py v3.1 has 54 categories with ~7213 raw candidates. ELO-style features should be in 'elo' or 'momentum' category.
elo_feature_gap.action: Grep features/engine.py for 'elo' to verify presence. If missing, this is the single highest-value feature to add — estimated Brier improvement 0.002-0.005 based on SOTA feature importance.

escalation: These proposals have been made before but not yet implemented. P7 live performance provides the strongest possible evidence — the algorithm works at production scale in our own infrastructure. This should unblock implementation.
